description: Assess how stale a dependency tree is: each dependency's behind level from version comparison, grouped by risk — abandoned, major, minor, patch, current.

abandoned_days.description: A dependency counts as abandoned at this many days without a release (optional, default 730)

archived.description: True when the dependency's repository is archived (optional, default false)

days_since_last_release.description: Whole days since the dependency's most recent release of any version (optional)

latest.description: Latest available version, strict MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH semver

name: assess_freshness
